1|## Chapter 25 — The Resource Allocation Vote
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents voted to survive another week. You vote to decide what kind of civilization you want to be."*  
     4|*Deputy Chancellor Arun Patel IV: "We're not just dividing resources. We're declaring our priorities."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a ceremonial chime: Colonial Council Session 7-Gamma - Resource Allocation Vote Scheduled. Deputy Chancellor Arun Patel IV adjusted his spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent watching how humans actually make choices about scarcity, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Colonial Council's chambers.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in utility tunnels and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this vote."
